phases.name: Adaptation
phases.description: Build the habit of regular running with walk-run intervals
phases.focus: Consistency and enjoyment over distance and pace
phases.coachNote: Use RPE (Rate of Perceived Exertion) only. Easy = can hold a conversation. Don't push — just show up.

phases.name: Building
phases.description: Increase running intervals and reduce walking breaks
phases.coachNote: You should start feeling stronger. Walk breaks get shorter, run segments grow longer.

phases.name: Consolidation
phases.focus: Sustained running without walking breaks — earn your 5K graduation
phases.coachNote: Progression: week 6 = 25 min, week 7 = 30 min, week 8 = 35 min continuous running (about 5K). Celebrate every milestone — the weekend of week 8 is your 5K graduation run!

Tue.name: Walk 5min + Run 3min × 4 sets
Tue.coachNote: RPE 3-4 during running. Brisk walk between runs.

Thu.name: Walk 5min + Run 3min × 4 sets
Thu.coachNote: Same as Tuesday. Consistency is the goal.

Sat.name: Walk 5min + Run 5min × 3 sets
Sat.coachNote: Longer run segments on the weekend!

Thu.name: Walk 3min + Run 8min × 3 sets
Thu.coachNote: Focus on breathing rhythm during 8-min segments.

Tue.name: Warm-up walk 3min + Run 25min
Tue.coachNote: W6: 20min / W7: 25min / W8: 25min. Find your comfortable rhythm.

Thu.name: Warm-up walk 3min + Run 25min
Thu.coachNote: W6: 20min / W7: 25min / W8: 30min. Steady and relaxed.

Sat.name: Walk 2min + Run 30min
Sat.coachNote: W6: 25min / W7: 30min / W8: 35min. Continuous running — you've earned this!

trainingPlan.name: 8-Week Beginner 5K Run
trainingPlan.description: A gentle introduction to running using walk-run intervals. Build from run-walk mixes to continuous running — graduation goal: run 5K without stopping.
trainingPlan.goal: Build a consistent running habit and run 5K continuously
